tag_meaning.NOT_WEBP: Not an optimized web file (PNG or JPG instead of WebP)
tag_meaning.SVG_WRAPPED_RASTER: SVG file that only wraps a bitmap
tag_meaning.NO_TRANSPARENCY: Opaque: background is baked in, no transparency
tag_meaning.BORDER_LINE: Dark or teal line along an edge (crop or grid line)
tag_meaning.TEAL_EDGE: Teal page edge or border color left in
tag_meaning.NEIGHBOR_FRAGMENT: Piece of a neighboring picture at an edge
tag_meaning.BG_RESIDUE: Page background or paper noise left around the picture
tag_meaning.MARGINS: Empty margin around the picture (picture fills under 82% of its frame)
tag_meaning.STALE_DELIVERY: The file the app loads is an older picture than the repo copy
tag_meaning.RAW_CROP: Looks like the raw book crop, not a cleaned picture
